title: New Zealand — North & South in One Trip
overview_paragraphs: New Zealand's North and South Islands feel like two different countries — geothermal valleys and Maori culture in the north, fjords and glacier-carved peaks in the south. This itinerary covers both ends properly rather than cramming everything into one island, with the famously scenic drives given the time they deserve.
Best for travelers who want dramatic scenery and outdoor activity without an expedition-level itinerary.

itinerary.title: Auckland & Rotorua
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Auckland, then continue to Rotorua for geothermal geysers, mud pools, and a traditional Maori cultural performance and hangi feast.

itinerary.title: Queenstown
itinerary.desc: Fly south to Queenstown, the adventure capital, with a Milford Sound or Doubtful Sound cruise through fjords and waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Wanaka & Fox Glacier
itinerary.desc: Scenic drive to Lake Wanaka and on to Fox Glacier for a guided glacier valley walk.

itinerary.title: Christchurch
itinerary.desc: Continue to Christchurch for the Botanic Gardens and a punting trip on the Avon River before your onward journey.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to Christchurch Airport for your international departure.
